name: save-boot-11b-stats-battle-atb-slots
description: #130: the ATB gauge layout for slots 1 and 2. From "stats-battle", wait until battle init has run (party[0].limitBar reads 100, as in 11a), mark "init", then 240 frames with no input: turn[i].atbGauge (i = 1 Barret, 2 Tifa; atb1_dir, atb2_dir) and g_ActiveCharacters[i].atbTimer (act1_dir, act2_dir) must have increased since the mark. Attempt 1 compared frame 300 with frame 240 after the battle started and saw no change, probably because both gauges were already full; init sets them to 0. Signs only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
